items.label: Corner Dog Crate
items.value: This indoor pet crate features a corner design that perfectly fits against the wall, helping maximize the utilization of corners in your home. It is ideal for small living spaces and provides a warm home for your dog

items.label: Haven for Small to Medium Dogs
items.value: With dimensions of 44.5"L x 23.6"W x 23.6"H, this multi-functional dog kennel is suitable for most small to medium-sized dogs (within 50 lb). It is an excellent choice for your furry companion to sleep, rest and relax

items.label: Versatile Dog Crate Furniture
items.value: This vintage decorative dog cage can be used not only as a dog house but also as a coffee table, side table, TV cabinet etc. The spacious top can withstand up to 220 lb, providing ample space to store and display your items

items.label: Sturdy and Durable
items.value: Made of metal mesh and high-quality engineered wood, this wooden dog furniture is stable and durable. It offers good ventilation and combines practicality with aesthetics, offering a solid shelter for your beloved pet

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: The package includes detailed instructions and all necessary accessories for easy assembly. It comes with two types of expansion screws, allowing you to choose the appropriate installation method based on your wall condition

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Anti-Tip Kit, 1 x Dog Crate, 1 x Instructions

items.label: Breed Recommendation
items.value: American Pit Bull Terrier, Am.Staffordshire Terrier, French Bulldog, Pembroke Welsh Corgi, Dachshund, Shetland Sheepdog, Welsh Corgi, etc

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Chewproof, Corner Design, Easy Assembly, Spacious
